auth.title: Sign in

activity.collected: Paid in for this activity: {paid} of {total}

expense.title: Expenses
expense.name: What for

payment.confirmDelete: Delete this payment? Balances will change.

member.rulesHint: Paying members owe every activity from their start date. Other members owe only activities they are listed on. Fixed amounts come first, then percentages of the total, then shares split the rest.
